name: Kagawa

flag.description: A white emblem on an olive green field: the katakana カ (ka) drawn as a rounded arch.
flag.symbolism: カ, the first sound of Kagawa, is drawn as the prefecture's mountains and as an olive leaf, an old sign of peace.

hook: Kagawa's white カ (ka) on olive green bends like an olive leaf, for the olives of Shōdoshima.
trivia: Kagawa is the smallest prefecture by area.
It is known as the "Udon Prefecture" for Sanuki udon noodles.
